caption: The drawing depicts a single figure, a woman, standing and facing slightly to the left. She is dressed in a long brown dress with a fitted bodice and a wide, full skirt that reaches down to her ankles. The dress has long sleeves and appears to be made of a heavy material. Over her shoulders, she wears a white shawl that crosses in the front and is tucked into her waistband. She has light gloves on both hands. The woman’s hair is styled in ringlets and covered by a brown bonnet with white trim that ties at her chin. She is wearing green shoes, which are partially visible beneath her skirt, with white stockings. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or scenery included. The drawing is signed with a small signature at the bottom right corner.
title: Doll - "Betsey Paine"
